description: Multi-core firmware template that hosts the TESAIoT practise examples on the Infineon PSoC Edge E84 (KIT_PSE84_AI) with the 4.3-inch display. Pre-configured with LVGL + VGLite GPU, direct sensor readers (BMI270/BMM350/DPS368/SHT4x), WiFi, and FreeRTOS. Drop a practise example into proj_cm55/apps/ and build a combined 3-core image.
display_name: TESAIoT Bento Kit Master Project Template
quick_start_steps: Clone the tesaiot_bento_kit_master branch and run 'make getlibs'.
Place a practise example into the 'proj_cm55/apps/' folder (sources live on the tesaiot_dev_kit_practise_codes branch).
Build the project with ModusToolbox ('make build') to produce a combined 3-core hex.
Flash the firmware to the PSoC Edge E84 board ('make program') and test the application.
